How Sustainable Is The AI Capex Boom?

Will Denyer

Gavekal Research | 14 Aug 2026

The AI capex boom is supporting economic growth, equity markets, and bond yields around the world. If the boom rolls over, it will not only weigh on the profits of companies directly exposed to AI capex spending, such as Nvidia. It would weigh on corporate profits throughout the economy (see Should Equity Investors Be Reassured By Record Corporate Profits?). In turn, that would weigh on equity prices, erasing much of the wealth effect supporting consumption—especially in the US (see How Far Can Wealth Effects Go?). Meanwhile, if companies stop borrowing to finance AI capex, they will remove a significant support for bond yields. And if the outlook for economic growth and profits deteriorates at the same time, yields on investment grade bonds will start to look a lot more attractive.In short, a rollover in the AI capex boom could lead to a reversal of today’s biggest macroeconomic and market trends. This means investors need constantly to be on the lookout for threats to the AI boom and signs that capex is rolling over.
